notable_quotes: PLATON analysis showed substantial porosity, with effective solvent-accessible volumes of 27.5% for 1 and 28.2% for 2.
The Zn MOF [Zn(atz)(bdc)0.5] was synthesized hydrothermally at 150 °C for 72 h and isolated in 88.4% yield.
Two isostructural amine-functionalized 3D self-penetrating microporous MOFs were reported to exhibit high CO2 sorption selectivity.
